purpose: Stress-test structural lineage in a recast where official correlation data distinguishes continuation, deletion and large relocation/renumbering. It also demonstrates that a correlation table alone does not prove proposition-level RULE_LINEAGE.

observations.note: Direct official correlation; structural correspondence only.
Large path displacement shows article-number proximity is not a lineage signal.

invariants: Official correlation establishes DIRECT STRUCTURAL_LINEAGE for the mapped containers.
A large structural-path change must not be classified by numeric distance or article-number similarity.
Correlation alone must not create RULE_LINEAGE or claim unchanged legal propositions.
Deletion and insertion are explicit outcomes, not failed matching.
